patterns.note: Content is presented as a vertical stack of distinct, slightly rotated, colored cards, each containing a project title, creating a layered, physical object aesthetic.

A stark contrast in typography, featuring an extremely large, bold, condensed sans-serif for the main brand, a medium-sized sans-serif for project titles, and tiny, almost monospaced text for header and footer details.
A diverse and vibrant palette of pastel and bright colors is used for the background of each project card, creating visual separation and a playful tone against a light, neutral background.
The very top-most header text elements ('GAME SAME BUT DIFFERENT', 'KNOCK@MEDIUMRARE.SITE') remain fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
The main content area is a single, continuous scrollable list of project cards, without distinct section breaks or navigation points other than the individual cards themselves.

technique_notes: To achieve the layered card effect, each content block is given a distinct background color, a subtle border-radius, and a fixed, slight 3D rotation with a soft drop shadow, making them appear as physical objects stacked on a surface.
The main brand title uses an extremely large, bold, and condensed sans-serif typeface, creating a strong visual anchor that dominates the initial view.
The top-most header elements are implemented with a sticky position, ensuring they remain visible and accessible at all scroll depths.

design_tokens.type_scale: An extremely oversized, bold, condensed display heading (~8x body) contrasts with a regular-weight body text and tiny, almost monospaced detail text (~0.5x body).
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to all interactive elements and content cards, giving a soft, friendly character.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with generous vertical spacing between the large brand title and the first card, and balanced spacing between subsequent cards.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its playful and tactile presentation of content as a stack of slightly rotated, vibrantly colored cards, each with a subtle drop shadow, creating a unique physical object aesthetic on a digital page. The extreme contrast in typography, with an enormous, bold brand name, further reinforces its unique and memorable identity.
